notes.title: Patch #4
notes.content: Fixed an ending slides issue, rewrote some endings to make sense in certain contexts, and changed how popular support affects election. Also centered the stuff on top which was sort of off balance. Tell me if anything else is awkwardly done or incorrect on discord.

notes.title: Economy Update
notes.content:
Added economy system. You get budget every month, and more every other month the more agricultural development and industrial development you get. Your authority and popular support decrease by 1 every four months. You can spend your budget on increasing agricultural or industrial development, the military, welfare, repression, and bribery. These increase certain variables and they must be managed to avoid bad events that potentially end your game. The ending slides have been somewhat rewritten and some bugs have been found and removed. The ending slides have been made to work with the new system. Make sure to join the discord to report any bugs that may have snuck in, or balancing that was bad.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42156405/e65c9f1b87fbbd47b7333a909b91e14b17fda901.png

notes.title: Price change and change to update schedule
notes.content: The price of the game has been reduced to 4.99, and I am moving ahead with updates. First one will come May 17th, second May 27th, and the third June 8th.
